prompt: Create a production pixel-art SPRITE SHEET of exactly SIX complete poses of the SAME owl from reference image 1. Image 2 is Pip's typing sheet: use its chunky pixel style, simple office-game readability, and full-body connected limb construction. Owl must keep pale slate-gray feathers, white facial mask and belly, round black glasses, small charcoal beak, small owl tufts and red scarf. No outfit changes. True transparent background. Layout: precisely THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows with generous transparent gutters, each pose centered in its own cell with same size, body registration and generous padding. No text or lines. TOP ROW: three front-three-quarter seated typing poses facing down-right (SE). Whole head, body, and two short connected wings leaning forward as if typing, two visible feet below. Frame 1 both wing tips low on an invisible keyboard; frame 2 near wing tip lifted a little; frame 3 far wing tip lifted a little. Bottom row: matching THREE rear-three-quarter typing poses facing up-left (NW), back of head and scarf visible, glasses side visible, wings reaching to an invisible keyboard in front. Frame1 both down; frame2 one raised; frame3 other raised. Wings are clearly attached at shoulders; exactly two wings, two feet. SAME proportions and silhouette in all poses. Each pose must be complete; NO desk, NO keyboard, NO computer, NO chair, NO props. The app draws these around the character. Crisp pixel stair-step contours, charcoal outlines, 8-10 flat colors, minimal shading. No blur, soft gradients, cast shadow, checkerboard, labels or watermark. Landscape sheet.
runtime: Nearest-neighbor, whole display-pixel anchors; low-alpha background fringe removed on an in-memory canvas.
